# Command help

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py. Don't edit by hand. -->

This page is the `--help` text of every command in openadapt 1.17.0, openadapt-flow 2.2.0, openadapt-agent 2.2.1.
It's generated from each program's parser, and CI fails when it differs
from those versions. [Commands](cli.md) explains what each command is
for. The launcher's research commands (`capture`, `eval`, `serve`, and
`train`) aren't listed.

`openadapt flow ...` runs `openadapt-flow ...`, and `openadapt agent ...`
runs `openadapt-agent ...`; the help text uses the second names.

## openadapt

### `openadapt`

```text
Usage: openadapt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  OpenAdapt launcher for the openadapt-flow compiler.

  Compile a demonstrated workflow into deterministic local replay. Healthy
  runs make no model calls; configured checks can halt on ambiguity. Native
  and remote substrates use platform-specific extras and permissions;
  training/evaluation commands are research.

  Quick Start (Python 3.10-3.12):
      python -m pip install --upgrade openadapt
      openadapt flow tutorial

  Halt demo:
      openadapt quickstart --break-it

  Manual Demo Lifecycle:
      openadapt flow demo-record --out rec
      openadapt flow compile rec --out bundle --name demo
      openadapt flow lint bundle
      openadapt flow certify bundle --policy permissive
      openadapt flow replay bundle

  Lint lists the demo's coverage gaps. The demo has warnings, so `lint
  --strict` exits 1 on it. The manual demo is runnable but not certified for
  consequential work. Use `openadapt flow tutorial` for the effect-verified
  first run.

  Give an MCP client your compiled workflows:
      openadapt agent serve --bundles DIR --allow-run

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  flow        Run the canonical demonstration compiler and governed runtime.
  agent       Serve compiled workflows to an MCP client (openadapt-agent).
  capture     Standalone local human GUI capture (optional [capture] extra).
  connect     Connect this computer to the signed-in OpenAdapt Cloud...
  deploy      Check this host and print the safe Flow/Desktop deployment...
  doctor      Check system requirements and dependencies.
  eval        Research: evaluate computer-use models on benchmarks.
  quickstart  Run a verified local tutorial against the bundled synthetic...
  seal        Check an OpenAdapt Seal offline: `openadapt seal verify...
  serve       Research: serve the training dashboard and viewer.
  train       Research: train ML models on captured demonstrations.
  version     Show version information for all packages.
```

### `openadapt agent`

```text
Usage: openadapt agent [OPTIONS]

  Serve compiled workflows to an MCP client (openadapt-agent).

  Every argument passes to openadapt-agent unchanged. Use this form where only
  `openadapt` is on PATH, as after `uv tool install openadapt` or pipx, which
  keep the `openadapt-agent` executable inside the tool's own environment.
  Nothing is written to stdout before the bridge starts, so an MCP client can
  launch this command directly.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt connect`

```text
Usage: openadapt connect [OPTIONS]

  Connect this computer to the signed-in OpenAdapt Cloud workspace.

  The browser creates a five-minute, one-use pairing. This command claims it
  and saves the resulting workspace credential in the OS keychain. It cannot
  execute arbitrary terminal commands or grant browser access to the shell.

Options:
  --pairing TEXT                  Five-minute pairing code from Cloud settings
  --uri TEXT                      Exact openadapt://connect desktop deep link
  --host TEXT                     Cloud origin (default:
                                  https://app.openadapt.ai)
  --device-name TEXT              Name shown for this computer
  --destination-kind [openadapt-managed|customer-managed|local]
                                  Trust class for the pairing destination
  --trusted-host TEXT             Exact allowed customer-managed origin
                                  (repeatable)
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt deploy`

```text
Usage: openadapt deploy [OPTIONS]

  Check this host and print the safe Flow/Desktop deployment path.

  This launcher command does not create another runtime or service manager. It
  records no secret value, starts no connector, and does not treat an
  incomplete preflight as a healthy deployment. It composes the installed Flow
  connector, operator console, and repair lifecycle instead.

Options:
  --backend [web|windows|macos|linux|rdp|citrix]
                                  The execution surface that this customer
                                  deployment will use.  [default: web]
  --secret-ref TEXT               Secret reference only: env:NAME or
                                  keychain:service/item. Never pass a secret
                                  value.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt doctor`

```text
Usage: openadapt doctor [OPTIONS]

  Check system requirements and dependencies.

Options:
  --backend [web|windows|macos|linux|rdp|citrix]
                                  Explain setup for one execution surface.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt flow`

```text
Usage: openadapt flow [OPTIONS]

  Run the canonical demonstration compiler and governed runtime.

  Every argument passes to openadapt-flow unchanged. This keeps the launcher
  command list, help, options, validation, and exit codes identical to the
  installed engine version.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt quickstart`

```text
Usage: openadapt quickstart [OPTIONS]

  Run a verified local tutorial against the bundled synthetic app.

  This is the shortest path to a real OpenAdapt run. It uses the bundled
  synthetic tutorial, verifies the write through an independent read-only
  system-of-record interface, keeps every artifact on this computer, and
  enables no model or Cloud call. The output directory is never overwritten.
  Other flags that the engine tutorial accepts (for example --guided or
  --interactive-record) pass through to it unchanged.

Options:
  --out PATH  Directory for the recording, bundle, and run report. Default:
              openadapt-quickstart, suffixed -2, -3, ... when taken.
  --headed    Show the browser while the tutorial runs.
  --break-it  After the verified run, rerun the same certified bundle against
              a fault-injecting backend and watch the engine halt instead of
              trusting the screen.
  --help      Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt seal`

```text
Usage: openadapt seal [OPTIONS]

  Check an OpenAdapt Seal offline: `openadapt seal verify <file|url>`.

  Also `openadapt seal keys pin` to pin Cloud's Seal keys after a person
  confirms them. Every argument passes to `openadapt-agent seal` unchanged.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt version`

```text
Usage: openadapt version [OPTIONS]

  Show version information for all packages.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## openadapt flow

### `openadapt-flow`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow [-h] [--version]
                      {demo,record,demo-record,tutorial,compile,induce,for-each,compose,process,replay,run,attach-seal,verify-run,resume,approve,item-approval,bench,benchmark,pull,intake,triage,lint,scaffold-verifier,explain,visualize,seal,countersign,bind-record-checks,certify,qualify,propose-qualification,disambiguate,emit-skill,emit-mcp,teach,teach-branch,repair,connect,login,sanitize,review-sanitized,materialize-approved,approve-sanitized,validate-hosted,push,report-break,report-run,console,serve-execute,serve-reward,business-decisions,connector,admit,check,jit}
                      ...

Record a task and compile it into a program that runs on this computer. With a record check
configured, a governed run confirms each save by reading the record back, and a run that can't
confirm a save stops and asks a person. When the screen changes, it finds the same field again or
stops, and a lasting fix needs a person's approval.

positional arguments:
  {demo,record,demo-record,tutorial,compile,induce,for-each,compose,process,replay,run,attach-seal,verify-run,resume,approve,item-approval,bench,benchmark,pull,intake,triage,lint,scaffold-verifier,explain,visualize,seal,countersign,bind-record-checks,certify,qualify,propose-qualification,disambiguate,emit-skill,emit-mcp,teach,teach-branch,repair,connect,login,sanitize,review-sanitized,materialize-approved,approve-sanitized,validate-hosted,push,report-break,report-run,console,serve-execute,serve-reward,business-decisions,connector,admit,check,jit}
    demo                See the proof in one command: a checked run and a run where the app lies,
                        side by side on one page (fake clinic data, no AI calls)
    record              Record YOUR workflow interactively: a headed browser (--backend web
                        --url), or the operator's real local desktop input through openadapt-
                        capture (--backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix)
    demo-record         Serve MockMed and record the canonical triage demo
    tutorial            Run the bundled tutorial end to end against a real local system of record:
                        record, compile, certify, govern, and VERIFY the write out of band, then
                        write a shareable local receipt
    compile             Compile a recording into a workflow bundle
    induce              Induce a parameterized PROGRAM bundle from MULTIPLE recordings (multi-
                        trace induction: infer params / loops / branches). REFUSES (nonzero exit,
                        no bundle) when intent is underdetermined, printing a record-next worklist
                        of missing demonstrations
    for-each            Author a DATA-DRIVEN LOOP bundle: wrap an existing single-demonstration
                        bundle's linear body in a LOOP that runs once per record of a worklist
                        (CSV/JSON), binding each record's columns to the workflow's parameters.
                        Emits a program:true bundle the runtime executes bounded, $0, identity-
                        gated and effect-verified per record
    compose             Author a parent sequencer from named compiled child bundles and a handoff
                        contract. Each child stays bound to its recorded surface. certify/run the
                        output directory.
    process             Author a ProcessContract parent from independently admitted capabilities.
                        Each --child needs a --admission envelope. certify/run the output
                        directory; replay refuses it.
    replay              Replay a bundle (serves the bundled MockMed demo app when no --url is
                        given)
    run                 Execute a bundle under a deployment config (--config): the replay path
                        wired for a real deployment (backend / effects / actuation / durable /
                        policy) instead of the demo
    attach-seal         Attach Cloud's signed Execute receipt (the Seal) to a VERIFIED run report
    verify-run          Read the system of record and rule on an effect that an agent, script, or
                        person claims it made; writes an unsigned openadapt.effect-receipt/v1. The
                        executor's own record is hashed, never trusted
    resume              Resume a durably-paused run from its last verified checkpoint (never re-
                        running an already-confirmed write)
    approve             Record an authenticated approval (approver / resolution / bundle version)
                        authorizing a durably-paused run to resume
    item-approval       List, approve or decline the per-item approval requests a run is waiting
                        on (Desktop's Run it)
    bench               Replay a bundle N times against MockMed and aggregate
    benchmark           Benchmark compiled replay vs. a Claude computer-use agent on the MockMed
                        triage task (agent arm needs an Anthropic API key and costs real money)
    pull                Download a packaged workflow bundle by name
    intake              Fill a workflow's parameters from a referral PDF, fax image, or email
    triage              Order verified saves for review and propose one batch approval
    lint                Report a bundle's coverage gaps (unarmed clicks, vacuous postconditions,
                        under-classified risk); exits nonzero by severity
    scaffold-verifier   Draft an effect-oracle contract (effect_contract.yaml) from a recording or
                        bundle's write-shaped steps. The output is a DRAFT requiring human edit;
                        refuses demonstrations with no consequential (write) step
    explain             Plain-language read of a completed run dir: what happened, why the outcome
                        is the safe one, and the next suggested command (read-only)
    visualize           See what a demonstration compiled INTO: emit a program-graph view of a
                        bundle or a composed parent (child bundles, --after DAG, effect-bound
                        handoffs) as self-contained HTML, Mermaid, or the shared JSON graph spec
    seal                Copy a bundle to a new path, encrypt its workflow and template evidence
                        with OPENADAPT_BUNDLE_KEY, verify integrity, and publish it atomically
    countersign         Timestamp, countersign, selectively disclose, and export a dispute dossier
                        for a Seal
    bind-record-checks  Attach reviewed record checks (system-of-record effect contracts) to a
                        compiled program's save step, in a new bundle; reports which entered
                        fields they compare
    certify             Enforce a policy on a bundle (exits nonzero + reports if it fails);
                        passing means the bundle meets that policy's rules, not that it is safe to
                        run
    qualify             Qualify: before a compiled workflow may run unattended on a real system,
                        run it against the normal case and deliberate faults, and confirm it is
                        verified by reading back the system of record and halts on every fault.
                        Also: create, edit, test, explain and certify the qualification project
                        sealed into a bundle.
    propose-qualification
                        Draft a production-shaped qualification contract from a compiled demo.
                        Alias of `qualify propose`.
    disambiguate        Surface compile-time multiple-choice questions for an ambiguous demo and
                        apply the answers as guards/params (ask, don't guess)
    emit-skill          Emit an Agent Skills folder for a bundle
    emit-mcp            Emit a standalone MCP server.py for a bundle
    teach               Self-serve HALT -> LEARN: resolve a halted run from a fix demonstration.
                        Induces the correction as a guarded exception branch, gates + validates
                        it, and writes an updated bundle ONLY if it passes (governed refusal
                        otherwise; nonzero exit)
    teach-branch        Learn a guarded branch from two or more halts resolved the same way. The
                        branch keys on the screen text they share (narrowed by an enum parameter
                        when normal runs show that text too) and is written as a repair candidate
                        that needs approval
    repair              Governed repair promotion lifecycle: register a proposed (healed or
                        taught) bundle as a CANDIDATE, review its diff, run the replay and fault
                        campaigns, approve (human), stage, canary, and roll back. A proposed
                        bundle NEVER becomes active without this lifecycle. See
                        docs/REPAIR_LIFECYCLE.md
    connect             Claim a one-time browser pairing and store the workspace credential in the
                        OS keychain
    login               Validate an ingest token against the hosted control plane and store it in
                        the OS keychain
    sanitize            Create a verified PHI-scrubbed derivative without modifying the original
    review-sanitized    Review original vs sanitized content in a loopback-only local viewer
    materialize-approved
                        Rebuild an approved derivative from its archive and approval record
    approve-sanitized   Approve and freeze the exact reviewed derivative as an immutable archive
    validate-hosted     Bind strict lint, policy certification, and a successful local replay to
                        an expiring Cloud challenge and exact approved artifacts. Standard and
                        Regulated activation also binds the sealed governed authorization
                        template.
    push                Upload the exact approved sanitized archive to /api/ingest; raw input is
                        sanitized locally and paused for review
    report-break        Emit a PHI-free break diagnostic from a halted run's report.json to
                        /api/runs/ingest-report (the recording stays local)
    report-run          Emit a PHI-free SUCCESS summary from a completed run's report.json to
                        /api/runs/ingest-report (bounded counts, duration, and exact pushed-bundle
                        identity — the recording stays local)
    console             Serve the operator console: a localhost-only web UI over compiled bundles,
                        run reports/halt evidence, and skill-library lineage. Read-only unless
                        --allow-actions; needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[console]'`
    serve-execute       Host the public Execute v1 HTTP+MCP contract locally. Receipts are self-
                        signed with a local key. They are not OpenAdapt production Seals. Needs
                        `pip install 'openadapt-flow[execute]'`
    serve-reward        Score training episodes by reading the system of record through an
                        independent oracle. Receipts are self-signed reward receipts, not Execute
                        Seals. Needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[reward]'`
    business-decisions  Customer-runner typed-decision relay; it never resumes or acts.
    connector           BYOC connector: enroll this machine with OpenAdapt Cloud and run governed
                        jobs LOCALLY (customer owns the data boundary; PHI stays on this side)
    admit               Read the published release-admission ledger. Does not sign or issue an
                        admission.
    check               Teach a save's read-back by demonstration, and admit it. Nothing confirms
                        a save until a person admits the check.
    jit                 Review, admit or reject a DRAFT compiled from a computer-use agent run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

New here? Run 'openadapt-flow demo' to see a checked run and a stopped run side by side on one
page.
```

### `openadapt-flow demo`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow demo [-h] [--out OUT] [--no-open] [--headed] [--verbose]

Run the bundled tutorial twice on a fake clinic app: once against an honest app, and once against
an app that shows its success message and then drops the save. Writes one self-contained HTML page
with both final screens, the record check for each run, and what a person sees when a run stops,
and opens it when a display is available. Exit 0 when the first run is Done and checked and the
second stopped; 1 when the pair didn't show that; 2 when the demo refused to start or lacked
evidence.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --out OUT      Folder for the page and both runs' evidence (default: ./openadapt-demo, then -2,
                 -3, ... so an earlier demo is never overwritten). An existing non-empty folder is
                 refused, and so is a folder an earlier demo used, even after it was deleted.
  --no-open      Write the page but don't open it in a browser
  --headed       Show the browser while the runs happen
  --verbose, -v  Also print each engine stage as it runs
```

### `openadapt-flow record`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow record [-h] [--url URL] [--browser-cdp-endpoint URL]
                             [--browser-page-url URL] --out OUT [--secret FIELD] [--param FIELD]
                             [--identifier FIELD|X,Y,W,H] [--task TASK] [--until-cmd CMD]
                             [--window OWNER] [--window-title SUBSTRING] [--headless]
                             [--profile {demo,standard,regulated}] [--with-check]
                             [--backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}] [--agent-url URL]
                             [--macos-app APP] [--macos-window-title TITLE] [--linux-app APP]
                             [--linux-window-title TITLE] [--linux-allow-physical-input]
                             [--rdp-host HOST] [--rdp-window OWNER] [--rdp-window-title TITLE]
                             [--rdp-readiness-text TEXT] [--allow-surface-override]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL             URL of the app to record against (required for --backend web)
  --browser-cdp-endpoint URL
                        Attach the web recorder to an already-running local Chromium browser
                        through its loopback DevTools endpoint (for example,
                        http://127.0.0.1:9222). The recorder selects a tab on the --url origin and
                        does not launch, navigate, or close the browser.
  --browser-page-url URL
                        Exact current URL of the existing tab to record. Use this with --browser-
                        cdp-endpoint when more than one open tab has the --url origin.
  --out OUT             Recording output directory
  --secret FIELD        Mark a typed field (by name or id) as a SECRET; its value is never
                        persisted and is injected at replay from OPENADAPT_FLOW_SECRET_<FIELD>.
                        input[type=password] is always treated as secret. Repeatable.
  --param FIELD         Record a typed value as a PARAMETER; its demonstrated value becomes the
                        default, overridable at replay with --param. For --backend web, FIELD is
                        the field name/id. For --backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix (capture
                        has no field identity), use NAME=VALUE — the typed value equal to VALUE is
                        marked as parameter NAME. Repeatable.
  --identifier FIELD|X,Y,W,H
                        Mark the RECORD-IDENTIFYING region (patient banner / MRN field) so the
                        compiler crops its pixels (anchor.identifier_crop) and the pixel-compare
                        identity tier arms on remote-display/pixel replays (Citrix/RDP). For
                        --backend web, FIELD is the field name/id (repeatable; the first marked
                        field present at each click contributes its rect). For --backend
                        windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix (a pixel capture has no field identity),
                        give the region once as X,Y,W,H in recording pixels. Unmarked recordings
                        still get automatic crops on identity-armed pixel steps (from the OCR
                        identity band).
  --task TASK           Task description for a desktop (--backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix)
                        capture session (stored in the recording metadata).
  --until-cmd CMD       Run CMD on an interval while recording. Exit 0 stops the record. The
                        command is not captured as clicks. Ctrl-C still stops. A non-zero exit
                        keeps recording (probe failure is not done).
  --window OWNER        Scope a desktop capture (--backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix) to ONE
                        window, recorded in that window's OWN pixel space (owner-app substring,
                        e.g. --window Parallels / --window 'Citrix Workspace'). Closes the
                        coordinate-space gap with the pixel (rdp) replay surface. Combine with
                        --window-title to disambiguate. Supported on macOS and Windows hosts;
                        refused elsewhere. Ignored (rejected) for --backend web.
  --window-title SUBSTRING
                        Title substring to disambiguate the --window target when the owner app has
                        multiple windows (case-insensitive; may be used with or without --window).
                        The resolved title is stored in the LOCAL recording metadata only.
  --headless            Run the browser headless (scripted/CI recording)
  --profile {demo,standard,regulated}
                        Recording posture (Section 5). standard/regulated REQUIRE an explicit
                        --backend (no implicit browser default in production). demo may omit
                        --backend: it defaults to capture on this OS (macos/windows/linux), or to
                        the browser when --url is given, and prints a visible notice. Omitted: the
                        same permissive pre-profile default.
  --with-check          After the save, also show how you'd check it saved (reload or search
                        again, open the record). Flow then asks which fields show the values you
                        typed and writes check.json
  --backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}
                        Backend to drive: 'web' (Playwright/Chromium), 'windows' (native Windows
                        via the WAA HTTP agent at replay), 'macos' (one native Mac app window),
                        'linux' (one exact AT-SPI app window at replay), 'rdp' (pixel-only network
                        or local remote desktop), or 'citrix' (the local Citrix Workspace window;
                        its owner defaults by host OS and a configured rdp_window may override
                        it). Overrides backend.kind from --config. Omit on record to capture on
                        this OS, or pass --url to record the browser.
  --agent-url URL       Base URL of the in-guest Windows (WAA) agent for --backend windows (e.g.
                        http://localhost:5001). Replay/run only: desktop record refuses this flag
                        because local Capture cannot bind to a WAA endpoint. Overrides
                        backend.agent_url.
  --macos-app APP       Owner application for --backend macos (e.g. TextEdit). During record this
                        scopes Capture to that local app window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_app.
  --macos-window-title TITLE
                        Window-title substring for --backend macos. Ambiguous matches are refused.
                        During record this scopes Capture; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_window_title.
  --linux-app APP       Exact AT-SPI application name for --backend linux (e.g. gedit). Replay/run
                        only: the current Capture path records the local Linux desktop and refuses
                        this flag. Overrides backend.linux_app.
  --linux-window-title TITLE
                        Exact top-level window title for --backend linux. Zero or multiple matches
                        are refused. Replay/run only: the current Capture path records the local
                        Linux desktop and refuses this flag. Overrides backend.linux_window_title.
  --linux-allow-physical-input
                        Explicitly allow window-bound X11 pointer/keyboard fallback for --backend
                        linux replay/run when native AT-SPI actuation is unavailable. Record
                        refuses this replay-only flag.
  --rdp-host HOST       RDP host/IP for --backend rdp (network RDP via FreeRDP). Overrides
                        backend.rdp_host. Replay/run only: record cannot connect local Capture to
                        this endpoint. Record inside the remote session, or capture a local client
                        with --window/--rdp-window.
  --rdp-window OWNER    Exact local remote-display window owner/process for --backend rdp or
                        citrix. On Windows this is the process basename (for example wfica32); on
                        macOS it is the app owner (for example 'Citrix Viewer'). During record it
                        also scopes local Capture to that window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.rdp_window.
  --rdp-window-title TITLE
                        Exact local remote-display window title used to disambiguate multiple
                        matching RDP/Citrix client windows. During record it also scopes local
                        Capture; during replay/run it overrides backend.rdp_window_title.
  --rdp-readiness-text TEXT
                        Stable text that must be visible in the current remote frame before input.
                        Required for governed Citrix `run`; overrides backend.rdp_readiness_text.
  --allow-surface-override
                        Explicitly permit executing a workflow on a DIFFERENT surface than the one
                        it was recorded/qualified on (Workflow.surface). Off by default: a cross-
                        surface run is refused. The override is recorded in the run report
                        (surface_override) as compatibility evidence; it is never silent.
```

### `openadapt-flow demo-record`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow demo-record [-h] --out OUT [--note-text NOTE_TEXT] [--param-name PARAM_NAME]
                                  [--drift DRIFT] [--headed] [--record-video DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             Recording output directory
  --note-text NOTE_TEXT
                        Note text typed during the demo (recorded as a parameter)
  --param-name PARAM_NAME
                        Parameter name for the note
  --drift DRIFT         Comma-separated MockMed drift modes
  --headed              Run the browser headed
  --record-video DIR    OPT-IN: capture a WebM video of the recording session into DIR (default:
                        off; no effect on the recording written to --out)
```

### `openadapt-flow tutorial`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow tutorial [-h] [--out OUT] [--name NAME] [--headed] [--guided]
                               [--interactive-record] [--presentation-delay SECONDS]
                               [--no-receipt] [--break-it]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             Directory for the tutorial's recording, bundle, and run (default:
                        tutorials/tutorial-<UTC timestamp> under the current directory)
  --name NAME           Workflow name for the compiled bundle (default: local-quickstart)
  --headed              Run the browser headed
  --guided              Presentation mode: record the demonstration yourself, then watch a visibly
                        paced governed replay
  --interactive-record  Perform the tutorial demonstration yourself in a headed browser; the
                        browser closes after the saved record is observed
  --presentation-delay SECONDS
                        Tutorial-only pause before each scripted recording action and replay step
                        (0-5 seconds; guided default: 1)
  --no-receipt          Skip writing the local receipt (the run and its report are unchanged)
  --break-it            After the clean VERIFIED run, rerun the SAME certified bundle against a
                        backend that silently rejects the write AFTER the app paints its success
                        banner -- and watch the engine HALT instead of believing the screen. The
                        halted run's evidence lands in <out>/run-broken/REPORT.md
```

### `openadapt-flow compile`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow compile [-h] --out OUT --name NAME [--accept-params NAME1,NAME2]
                              [--params-from FILE] [--no-confirm-params] [--pixel-verify-enabled]
                              recording

positional arguments:
  recording             Recording directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             Output bundle directory
  --name NAME           Workflow name
  --accept-params NAME1,NAME2
                        Non-interactive confirm pass: accept these flagged field-label parameter
                        proposals as-is (comma-separated proposed names; see param_proposals.json
                        in the bundle). Proposals not listed stay demonstrated constants. Unknown
                        names fail loud.
  --params-from FILE    Non-interactive confirm pass: JSON decision file mapping each proposed
                        name to {"action": "confirm"|"rename"|"secret"|"constant", "name": "<new
                        name, for rename>"}. Unlisted proposals stay constants (fail-closed).
  --no-confirm-params   Skip the interactive parameter review even on a TTY; flagged proposals
                        stay demonstrated constants.
  --pixel-verify-enabled
                        The runtime that will run this bundle sets runtime.pixel_verify_enabled.
                        Lets the compiler give an unlabeled button a pixel identifier crop as its
                        identity check. Without it the compiler doesn't, because a crop that can't
                        be verified halts an irreversible step on every run.
```

### `openadapt-flow induce`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow induce [-h] --out OUT [--name NAME] [--held-out] recording [recording ...]

positional arguments:
  recording    Two or more recording directories (or already-compiled bundle directories) of the
               SAME task

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --out OUT    Output program-bundle directory (written only when CERTIFIED)
  --name NAME  Name for the induced workflow (default: 'induced-program')
  --held-out   Also run leave-one-out held-out validation and print the per-fold reproduction
               scores (needs >= 2 traces)
```

### `openadapt-flow for-each`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow for-each [-h] --records RECORDS --out OUT [--map COLUMN=PARAM]
                               [--relation RELATION] [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS]
                               [--loop-var LOOP_VAR] [--name NAME]
                               bundle

positional arguments:
  bundle                Existing single-demonstration bundle directory (the linear body)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --records RECORDS     Worklist file (.csv header names columns, or .json list of row objects);
                        one record = one loop iteration
  --out OUT             Output program-bundle directory
  --map COLUMN=PARAM    Map a worklist COLUMN to a workflow PARAM (repeatable). Omit to map each
                        column to the parameter of the same name. Every column must map to a known
                        non-secret parameter or authoring FAILS LOUDLY.
  --relation RELATION   Name of the emitted loop relation (default: 'worklist')
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS
                        Hard fail-safe bound on iterations (default 1000); a worklist longer than
                        this is refused at authoring time and HALTs at run time
  --loop-var LOOP_VAR   Optional human label for the loop variable (reports only)
  --name NAME           Name for the looped workflow (default: '<body>-for-each')
```

### `openadapt-flow compose`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow compose [-h] --child NAME=PATH [--handoff FROM.source=TO.target]
                              [--after NAME=PRED[,PRED]] [--allow-halt NAME=OUTCOME] --out OUT
                              [--name NAME]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --child NAME=PATH     Named compiled child bundle (repeat; at least two)
  --handoff FROM.source=TO.target
                        Verified fact copied from a predecessor effect-bound parameter into a
                        successor parameter. Repeatable. Missing evidence HALTs.
  --after NAME=PRED[,PRED]
                        Explicit DAG predecessors for NAME. Omit to run children in --child order.
  --allow-halt NAME=OUTCOME
                        Let NAME start when a predecessor ended OUTCOME instead of VERIFIED
                        (HALTED, FAILED, ...). VERIFIED is always allowed.
  --out OUT             Output composition directory
  --name NAME           Composition name
```

### `openadapt-flow process`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow process [-h] [--child NAME=BUNDLE] [--spec PATH] [--admission NAME=ENVELOPE]
                              [--handoff FROM.source=TO.target] [--after NAME=PRED[,PRED]]
                              [--allow-halt NAME=OUTCOME] [--input NAME] --out OUT [--name NAME]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --child NAME=BUNDLE   Named admitted child bundle pointer (repeat; at least two)
  --spec PATH           Complete openadapt.process-contract/v1 JSON document. Use this for mixed
                        Flow, code, human, and artifact-edge contracts.
  --admission NAME=ENVELOPE
                        QualificationAdmissionEnvelope for NAME. A compiled recording without an
                        envelope is not an admitted capability.
  --handoff FROM.source=TO.target
                        Verified fact copied from a predecessor effect-bound parameter into a
                        successor parameter. Repeatable. Missing evidence HALTs.
  --after NAME=PRED[,PRED]
                        Explicit DAG predecessors for NAME. Omit to run children in --child order.
  --allow-halt NAME=OUTCOME
                        Let the parent absorb NAME ending OUTCOME instead of VERIFIED and continue
                        to successors without minting facts from NAME.
  --input NAME          Parent-level parameter name (values arrive at run time)
  --out OUT             Output process-contract directory
  --name NAME           Process contract name
```

### `openadapt-flow replay`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow replay [-h] [--url URL] [--drift DRIFT] [--run-dir RUN_DIR] [--param K=V]
                             [--params-file PARAMS_FILE] [--allow-model-grounding]
                             [--save-healed-to SAVE_HEALED_TO] [--headed] [--record-video DIR]
                             [--backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}] [--agent-url URL]
                             [--macos-app APP] [--macos-window-title TITLE] [--linux-app APP]
                             [--linux-window-title TITLE] [--linux-allow-physical-input]
                             [--rdp-host HOST] [--rdp-window OWNER] [--rdp-window-title TITLE]
                             [--rdp-readiness-text TEXT] [--allow-surface-override]
                             [--browser-cdp-endpoint URL] [--browser-page-url URL] [--config YAML]
                             [--effects-kind {none,rest,fhir,sql,file,document-hash}]
                             [--effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL] [--effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT]
                             [--api-actuator] [--api-base-url API_BASE_URL] [--durable]
                             [--worklist [RELATION=]FILE] [--attest-contract PATH]
                             [--attest-sign-key PATH] [--attest-audit-log PATH]
                             [--attest-pre-state PATH]
                             bundle

positional arguments:
  bundle                Workflow bundle directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL             URL of the target app (default: serve the bundled MockMed demo app)
  --drift DRIFT         Comma-separated MockMed drift modes (theme,move,rename,modal) to
                        demonstrate bounded drift resolution; only valid without --url
  --run-dir RUN_DIR     Run output directory (default: runs/replay-<UTC timestamp> under the
                        current directory)
  --param K=V           Parameter substitution (repeatable)
  --params-file PARAMS_FILE
                        JSON object of parameter bindings; keeps values out of process arguments
                        for managed execution
  --allow-model-grounding
                        EGRESS OPT-IN (PHI audit REM-3): permit wiring an off-box model grounder /
                        identity-VLM / state-verifier (a paid API or an on-prem VLM appliance via
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_VLM_URL). Screenshots may leave the box. Off by default:
                        replay is fully local with zero outbound calls.
  --save-healed-to SAVE_HEALED_TO
                        Write the healed bundle to this directory
  --headed              Run the browser headed
  --record-video DIR    OPT-IN: capture a WebM video of the replay session into DIR (default: off;
                        no effect on the run directory or report)
  --backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}
                        Backend to drive: 'web' (Playwright/Chromium), 'windows' (native Windows
                        via the WAA HTTP agent at replay), 'macos' (one native Mac app window),
                        'linux' (one exact AT-SPI app window at replay), 'rdp' (pixel-only network
                        or local remote desktop), or 'citrix' (the local Citrix Workspace window;
                        its owner defaults by host OS and a configured rdp_window may override
                        it). Overrides backend.kind from --config. Omit on record to capture on
                        this OS, or pass --url to record the browser.
  --agent-url URL       Base URL of the in-guest Windows (WAA) agent for --backend windows (e.g.
                        http://localhost:5001). Replay/run only: desktop record refuses this flag
                        because local Capture cannot bind to a WAA endpoint. Overrides
                        backend.agent_url.
  --macos-app APP       Owner application for --backend macos (e.g. TextEdit). During record this
                        scopes Capture to that local app window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_app.
  --macos-window-title TITLE
                        Window-title substring for --backend macos. Ambiguous matches are refused.
                        During record this scopes Capture; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_window_title.
  --linux-app APP       Exact AT-SPI application name for --backend linux (e.g. gedit). Replay/run
                        only: the current Capture path records the local Linux desktop and refuses
                        this flag. Overrides backend.linux_app.
  --linux-window-title TITLE
                        Exact top-level window title for --backend linux. Zero or multiple matches
                        are refused. Replay/run only: the current Capture path records the local
                        Linux desktop and refuses this flag. Overrides backend.linux_window_title.
  --linux-allow-physical-input
                        Explicitly allow window-bound X11 pointer/keyboard fallback for --backend
                        linux replay/run when native AT-SPI actuation is unavailable. Record
                        refuses this replay-only flag.
  --rdp-host HOST       RDP host/IP for --backend rdp (network RDP via FreeRDP). Overrides
                        backend.rdp_host. Replay/run only: record cannot connect local Capture to
                        this endpoint. Record inside the remote session, or capture a local client
                        with --window/--rdp-window.
  --rdp-window OWNER    Exact local remote-display window owner/process for --backend rdp or
                        citrix. On Windows this is the process basename (for example wfica32); on
                        macOS it is the app owner (for example 'Citrix Viewer'). During record it
                        also scopes local Capture to that window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.rdp_window.
  --rdp-window-title TITLE
                        Exact local remote-display window title used to disambiguate multiple
                        matching RDP/Citrix client windows. During record it also scopes local
                        Capture; during replay/run it overrides backend.rdp_window_title.
  --rdp-readiness-text TEXT
                        Stable text that must be visible in the current remote frame before input.
                        Required for governed Citrix `run`; overrides backend.rdp_readiness_text.
  --allow-surface-override
                        Explicitly permit executing a workflow on a DIFFERENT surface than the one
                        it was recorded/qualified on (Workflow.surface). Off by default: a cross-
                        surface run is refused. The override is recorded in the run report
                        (surface_override) as compatibility evidence; it is never silent.
  --browser-cdp-endpoint URL
                        Run in an already-running, signed-in local Chromium through its loopback
                        DevTools endpoint (for example, http://127.0.0.1:9222) instead of
                        launching a new, signed-out browser. The run binds the one open tab on the
                        --url origin, starts from the screen it shows, and never navigates or
                        closes the browser. Overrides backend.browser_cdp_endpoint from --config.
  --browser-page-url URL
                        Exact current URL of the tab to run in, when more than one open tab has
                        the --url origin. Requires --browser-cdp-endpoint.
  --config YAML         Deployment config YAML wiring backend / actuation / effects / runtime /
                        policy (see docs/deployment.example.yaml). Direct flags below override
                        individual fields.
  --effects-kind {none,rest,fhir,sql,file,document-hash}
                        System-of-record EffectVerifier to wire so consequential writes are
                        verified against the real record (not the screen). The sql/file kinds need
                        their config fields (sql_query, root, ...) from a --config deployment YAML
  --effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the rest / fhir effect verifier
  --effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT
                        Document-store root for the document-hash effect verifier
  --api-actuator        Wire the API/tool actuation tier: a step carrying an ApiBinding is
                        performed via the API (deterministic, $0) and confirmed by the effect
                        verifier, skipping the GUI
  --api-base-url API_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the API actuator (implies --api-actuator)
  --durable             Enable the Tier-3 durable runtime: checkpoint each verified step and
                        durably PAUSE on halt, so the run is resumable via `resume` (never re-
                        performing a confirmed write)
  --worklist [RELATION=]FILE
                        CSV/JSON worklist of parameter rows driving a PROGRAM bundle's loop over a
                        relation (repeatable). 'RELATION=FILE' binds the file to that relation; a
                        bare 'FILE' binds to the program's sole loop relation.
  --attest-contract PATH
                        OPT-IN: effect-contract YAML for the openadapt-attest proof sidecar. After
                        the run it verifies the claimed effect against the system of record and
                        writes a SIGNED receipt (attest_receipt.json) into the run directory.
                        Never changes the run outcome or exit code. Env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_CONTRACT
  --attest-sign-key PATH
                        Signing key for the attest receipt (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_SIGN_KEY)
  --attest-audit-log PATH
                        Append-only audit log the attest sidecar writes to (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_AUDIT_LOG)
  --attest-pre-state PATH
                        Existing pre-actuation system-of-record snapshot for delta checks. When
                        omitted, replay captures one into the run directory
                        (attest_pre_state.json) before actuation begins (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_PRE_STATE)
```

### `openadapt-flow run`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow run [-h] [--profile {demo,standard,regulated}] [--url URL]
                          [--run-dir RUN_DIR] [--param K=V] [--params-file PARAMS_FILE]
                          [--allow-model-grounding] [--save-healed-to SAVE_HEALED_TO] [--headed]
                          [--hold-on-halt SECONDS]

                          [--linux-window-title TITLE] [--linux-allow-physical-input]
                          [--rdp-host HOST] [--rdp-window OWNER] [--rdp-window-title TITLE]
                          [--rdp-readiness-text TEXT] [--allow-surface-override]
                          [--browser-cdp-endpoint URL] [--browser-page-url URL] [--config YAML]

                          [--effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL] [--effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT]
                          [--api-actuator] [--api-base-url API_BASE_URL] [--durable]
                          [--worklist [RELATION=]FILE] [--attest-contract PATH]
                          [--attest-sign-key PATH] [--attest-audit-log PATH]
                          [--attest-pre-state PATH] [--policy NAME-OR-PATH]
                          [--approve-unverified-writes] [--strict-templates] [--allow-unencrypted]
                          [--pin-digest SHA256] [--pin-version VERSION]
                          [--qualification-trust PATH] [--execute-url URL]
                          [--execute-environment-id ID] [--code-trust PATH]
                          [--code-runtime-environment-digest SHA256] [--allow-trusted-code]
                          [--process-receipt-private-key PATH]
                          [--process-receipt-issuer-key-id PROCESS_RECEIPT_ISSUER_KEY_ID]
                          [--process-environment-id PROCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ID]
                          [--process-runner-id PROCESS_RUNNER_ID]

                          [--cloud-execution-id CLOUD_EXECUTION_ID] [--approver-policy FILE]

                          [--approval-wait SECONDS]
                          bundle

positional arguments:
  bundle                Workflow bundle directory

options:

  --profile {demo,standard,regulated}

                        explicitly non-production; Standard requires certification, durability,
                        identity, and independently verified consequential effects. Regulated
                        additionally requires encrypted bundles, strictly sealed evidence assets,
                        and encrypted durable checkpoints in a customer-controlled deployment.
                        Omit only for compatibility with a pre-profile deployment.

                        for managed execution
  --allow-model-grounding

                        (also settable via runtime.allow_model_grounding)
  --save-healed-to SAVE_HEALED_TO
                        Write the healed bundle to this directory
  --headed              Run the browser headed
  --hold-on-halt SECONDS
                        When a browser run halts, keep its page open for up to SECONDS so
                        openadapt-agent can record a repair on it (see
                        openadapt_flow.repair.hold). 0, the default, closes it at once. Max 1800.

                        via the WAA HTTP agent at replay), 'macos' (one native Mac app window),

                        because local Capture cannot bind to a WAA endpoint. Overrides
                        backend.agent_url.
  --macos-app APP       Owner application for --backend macos (e.g. TextEdit). During record this
                        scopes Capture to that local app window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_app.
  --macos-window-title TITLE

                        During record this scopes Capture; during replay/run it overrides

  --linux-app APP       Exact AT-SPI application name for --backend linux (e.g. gedit). Replay/run

  --linux-window-title TITLE

                        Linux desktop and refuses this flag. Overrides backend.linux_window_title.
  --linux-allow-physical-input
                        Explicitly allow window-bound X11 pointer/keyboard fallback for --backend
                        linux replay/run when native AT-SPI actuation is unavailable. Record
                        refuses this replay-only flag.
  --rdp-host HOST       RDP host/IP for --backend rdp (network RDP via FreeRDP). Overrides
                        backend.rdp_host. Replay/run only: record cannot connect local Capture to
                        this endpoint. Record inside the remote session, or capture a local client
                        with --window/--rdp-window.
  --rdp-window OWNER    Exact local remote-display window owner/process for --backend rdp or

                        macOS it is the app owner (for example 'Citrix Viewer'). During record it

  --rdp-readiness-text TEXT

  --allow-surface-override
                        Explicitly permit executing a workflow on a DIFFERENT surface than the one
                        it was recorded/qualified on (Workflow.surface). Off by default: a cross-
                        surface run is refused. The override is recorded in the run report

  --browser-cdp-endpoint URL

  --browser-page-url URL
                        Exact current URL of the tab to run in, when more than one open tab has

  --config YAML         Deployment config YAML wiring backend / actuation / effects / runtime /
                        policy (see docs/deployment.example.yaml). Direct flags below override
                        individual fields.
  --effects-kind {none,rest,fhir,sql,file,document-hash}
                        System-of-record EffectVerifier to wire so consequential writes are
                        verified against the real record (not the screen). The sql/file kinds need
                        their config fields (sql_query, root, ...) from a --config deployment YAML
  --effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the rest / fhir effect verifier
  --effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT
                        Document-store root for the document-hash effect verifier
  --api-actuator        Wire the API/tool actuation tier: a step carrying an ApiBinding is
                        performed via the API (deterministic, $0) and confirmed by the effect
                        verifier, skipping the GUI
  --api-base-url API_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the API actuator (implies --api-actuator)
  --durable             Enable the Tier-3 durable runtime: checkpoint each verified step and
                        durably PAUSE on halt, so the run is resumable via `resume` (never re-
                        performing a confirmed write)
  --worklist [RELATION=]FILE
                        CSV/JSON worklist of parameter rows driving a PROGRAM bundle's loop over a
                        relation (repeatable). 'RELATION=FILE' binds the file to that relation; a
                        bare 'FILE' binds to the program's sole loop relation.
  --attest-contract PATH
                        OPT-IN: effect-contract YAML for the openadapt-attest proof sidecar. After
                        the run it verifies the claimed effect against the system of record and
                        writes a SIGNED receipt (attest_receipt.json) into the run directory.
                        Never changes the run outcome or exit code. Env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_CONTRACT
  --attest-sign-key PATH
                        Signing key for the attest receipt (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_SIGN_KEY)
  --attest-audit-log PATH
                        Append-only audit log the attest sidecar writes to (env fallback:

  --attest-pre-state PATH
                        Existing pre-actuation system-of-record snapshot for delta checks. When

                        (attest_pre_state.json) before actuation begins (env fallback:

  --policy NAME-OR-PATH

  --approve-unverified-writes

  --process-receipt-private-key PATH

  --process-receipt-issuer-key-id PROCESS_RECEIPT_ISSUER_KEY_ID
  --process-environment-id PROCESS_ENVIRONMENT_ID
  --process-runner-id PROCESS_RUNNER_ID
  --qualification-authority-file PATH
                        Private owner-only Production qualification authority (v2 envelope or
                        issued openadapt.qualification-admission/v4). Required for Standard and
                        Regulated actuation; verified and re-read at every input edge
  --dry-run, --explain  Print the fail-closed coverage report and exit WITHOUT executing
  --report              OPT-IN: after a SUCCESSFUL run, emit the PHI-free run summary to the
                        paired hosted control plane (see `report-run`). Off by default — nothing
                        is ever uploaded without this flag (or OPENADAPT_FLOW_REPORT_RUN=1)
  --cloud-execution-id CLOUD_EXECUTION_ID
                        OpenAdapt Cloud Execute execution this run belongs to (or
                        OPENADAPT_CLOUD_EXECUTION_ID). After a VERIFIED outcome, Cloud's signed
                        receipt is fetched with OPENADAPT_EXECUTE_API_KEY and written into
                        report.json as execute_receipt.
  --approver-policy FILE
                        An openadapt.approver-policy/v1 JSON file: which kinds of approver
                        (person, rule, agent, system) may answer each class of save. Without it
                        only a person may answer. A clinical_write save takes a non-person
                        approver only when the policy pins an opt-in.
  --approver-webhook URL
                        Ask this https endpoint (the customer's approver agent or system) about
                        each waiting save, with HMAC-signed, PHI-free messages. The secret is read
                        from OPENADAPT_APPROVER_WEBHOOK_SECRET. A person can still answer in
                        Desktop. Needs --approver-webhook-id and a policy that allows the
                        approver's kind.
  --approver-webhook-id APPROVER_WEBHOOK_ID
                        The webhook approver's opaque id, such as system:acme-approvals
  --approver-webhook-kind {agent,system}
                        Whether the webhook approver is an agent or a system (default system)
  --approval-mode {each_item,problems_only,not_gated}
                        Per-item approval before each consequential save. each_item (the default
                        for every run): the run waits before every save until a person approves it
                        in Desktop's Run it (see `item-approval`). problems_only: only problems go
                        to a person; until a switch record is configured, every save still asks.
                        not_gated: no per-item pause, recorded in the report (the hosted runner,
                        Execute and MCP callers). Overrides runtime.approval_mode. A resume always
                        keeps the run's own mode.
  --approval-wait SECONDS
                        How long the run waits for a person's answer before it stops before the
                        save (default 900, at most 14400). An answer given later can still be used
                        by `resume`.
```

### `openadapt-flow verify-run`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow verify-run [-h] [--verify YAML] [--params JSON] [--run-record JSON]
                                 [--authorization-ref AUTHORIZATION_REF] [--baseline JSON]
                                 [--capture-baseline JSON] [--out DIR] [--check JSON]
                                 [--keys JSON]
                                 [--accept-outcome {halted_before_effect,reconciliation_required,rejected_policy,failed_platform}]
                                 [--approver JSON] [--remediates RECEIPT_ID] [--correlation-id ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --verify YAML         verify.yaml: verifier wiring and effect contract
  --params JSON         The authorized task's values the contract binds
  --run-record JSON     The executor's run record (needs executor_kind)
  --authorization-ref AUTHORIZATION_REF
                        Opaque id of the authorization in your own system
  --baseline JSON       Baseline captured before the executor ran
  --capture-baseline JSON
                        Read the store now and write a private baseline, then exit
  --out DIR             Directory for effect-receipt.json
  --check JSON          Check a signed effect receipt offline instead
  --keys JSON           Pinned Seal key registry for --check
  --accept-outcome {halted_before_effect,reconciliation_required,rejected_policy,failed_platform}
                        With --check: also exit 0 for this outcome when the signature is genuine
                        (repeatable; no value accepts every outcome)
  --approver JSON       Who approved the write: {kind, id, policy_ref}; id is opaque
  --remediates RECEIPT_ID
                        receipt_id of an earlier effect receipt this run remediates
  --correlation-id ID   Your own opaque id linking this receipt to a ticket or trace
```

### `openadapt-flow resume`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow resume [-h] [--qualification-authority-file PATH]
                             [--qualification-campaign-authority-file PATH] [--url URL] [--headed]
                             [--require-approval] [--report] [--param K=V]
                             [--params-file PARAMS_FILE]
                             [--backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}] [--agent-url URL]
                             [--macos-app APP] [--macos-window-title TITLE] [--linux-app APP]
                             [--linux-window-title TITLE] [--linux-allow-physical-input]
                             [--rdp-host HOST] [--rdp-window OWNER] [--rdp-window-title TITLE]
                             [--rdp-readiness-text TEXT] [--allow-surface-override]
                             [--browser-cdp-endpoint URL] [--browser-page-url URL] [--config YAML]
                             [--effects-kind {none,rest,fhir,sql,file,document-hash}]
                             [--effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL] [--effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT]
                             [--api-actuator] [--api-base-url API_BASE_URL] [--durable]
                             [--attest-contract PATH] [--attest-sign-key PATH]
                             [--attest-audit-log PATH] [--attest-pre-state PATH]
                             [--approver-policy FILE] [--approver-webhook URL]
                             [--approver-webhook-id APPROVER_WEBHOOK_ID]
                             [--approver-webhook-kind {agent,system}]
                             [--approval-mode {each_item,problems_only,not_gated}]
                             [--approval-wait SECONDS]
                             run_dir

positional arguments:
  run_dir               The paused run directory (holds checkpoints)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --qualification-authority-file PATH
                        Private owner-only Production qualification authority for the resumed
                        input edge
  --qualification-campaign-authority-file PATH
                        Private signed non-production campaign authority for a resumed
                        qualification input edge
  --url URL             Target app URL to rebuild a live backend (default: backend.url)
  --headed              Run the browser headed
  --require-approval    Refuse to resume unless the pending escalation is 'approved' (see
                        `approve`)
  --report              After a successful resume, send the PHI-minimal local completion summary
                        to the paired control plane (also enabled by OPENADAPT_FLOW_REPORT_RUN=1)
  --param K=V           Parameter substitution (repeatable); required again on resume when the
                        effect-verifier config binds run parameters
  --params-file PARAMS_FILE
                        JSON object of parameter bindings; keeps values out of process arguments
                        for managed execution (see --param)
  --backend {web,windows,macos,linux,rdp,citrix}
                        Backend to drive: 'web' (Playwright/Chromium), 'windows' (native Windows
                        via the WAA HTTP agent at replay), 'macos' (one native Mac app window),
                        'linux' (one exact AT-SPI app window at replay), 'rdp' (pixel-only network
                        or local remote desktop), or 'citrix' (the local Citrix Workspace window;
                        its owner defaults by host OS and a configured rdp_window may override
                        it). Overrides backend.kind from --config. Omit on record to capture on
                        this OS, or pass --url to record the browser.
  --agent-url URL       Base URL of the in-guest Windows (WAA) agent for --backend windows (e.g.
                        http://localhost:5001). Replay/run only: desktop record refuses this flag
                        because local Capture cannot bind to a WAA endpoint. Overrides
                        backend.agent_url.
  --macos-app APP       Owner application for --backend macos (e.g. TextEdit). During record this
                        scopes Capture to that local app window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_app.
  --macos-window-title TITLE
                        Window-title substring for --backend macos. Ambiguous matches are refused.
                        During record this scopes Capture; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.macos_window_title.
  --linux-app APP       Exact AT-SPI application name for --backend linux (e.g. gedit). Replay/run
                        only: the current Capture path records the local Linux desktop and refuses
                        this flag. Overrides backend.linux_app.
  --linux-window-title TITLE
                        Exact top-level window title for --backend linux. Zero or multiple matches
                        are refused. Replay/run only: the current Capture path records the local
                        Linux desktop and refuses this flag. Overrides backend.linux_window_title.
  --linux-allow-physical-input
                        Explicitly allow window-bound X11 pointer/keyboard fallback for --backend
                        linux replay/run when native AT-SPI actuation is unavailable. Record
                        refuses this replay-only flag.
  --rdp-host HOST       RDP host/IP for --backend rdp (network RDP via FreeRDP). Overrides
                        backend.rdp_host. Replay/run only: record cannot connect local Capture to
                        this endpoint. Record inside the remote session, or capture a local client
                        with --window/--rdp-window.
  --rdp-window OWNER    Exact local remote-display window owner/process for --backend rdp or
                        citrix. On Windows this is the process basename (for example wfica32); on
                        macOS it is the app owner (for example 'Citrix Viewer'). During record it
                        also scopes local Capture to that window; during replay/run it overrides
                        backend.rdp_window.
  --rdp-window-title TITLE
                        Exact local remote-display window title used to disambiguate multiple
                        matching RDP/Citrix client windows. During record it also scopes local
                        Capture; during replay/run it overrides backend.rdp_window_title.
  --rdp-readiness-text TEXT
                        Stable text that must be visible in the current remote frame before input.
                        Required for governed Citrix `run`; overrides backend.rdp_readiness_text.
  --allow-surface-override
                        Explicitly permit executing a workflow on a DIFFERENT surface than the one
                        it was recorded/qualified on (Workflow.surface). Off by default: a cross-
                        surface run is refused. The override is recorded in the run report
                        (surface_override) as compatibility evidence; it is never silent.
  --browser-cdp-endpoint URL
                        Run in an already-running, signed-in local Chromium through its loopback
                        DevTools endpoint (for example, http://127.0.0.1:9222) instead of
                        launching a new, signed-out browser. The run binds the one open tab on the
                        --url origin, starts from the screen it shows, and never navigates or
                        closes the browser. Overrides backend.browser_cdp_endpoint from --config.
  --browser-page-url URL
                        Exact current URL of the tab to run in, when more than one open tab has
                        the --url origin. Requires --browser-cdp-endpoint.
  --config YAML         Deployment config YAML wiring backend / actuation / effects / runtime /
                        policy (see docs/deployment.example.yaml). Direct flags below override
                        individual fields.
  --effects-kind {none,rest,fhir,sql,file,document-hash}
                        System-of-record EffectVerifier to wire so consequential writes are
                        verified against the real record (not the screen). The sql/file kinds need
                        their config fields (sql_query, root, ...) from a --config deployment YAML
  --effects-base-url EFFECTS_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the rest / fhir effect verifier
  --effects-root EFFECTS_ROOT
                        Document-store root for the document-hash effect verifier
  --api-actuator        Wire the API/tool actuation tier: a step carrying an ApiBinding is
                        performed via the API (deterministic, $0) and confirmed by the effect
                        verifier, skipping the GUI
  --api-base-url API_BASE_URL
                        Base URL for the API actuator (implies --api-actuator)
  --durable             Enable the Tier-3 durable runtime: checkpoint each verified step and
                        durably PAUSE on halt, so the run is resumable via `resume` (never re-
                        performing a confirmed write)
  --attest-contract PATH
                        OPT-IN: effect-contract YAML for the openadapt-attest proof sidecar. After
                        the run it verifies the claimed effect against the system of record and
                        writes a SIGNED receipt (attest_receipt.json) into the run directory.
                        Never changes the run outcome or exit code. Env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_CONTRACT
  --attest-sign-key PATH
                        Signing key for the attest receipt (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_SIGN_KEY)
  --attest-audit-log PATH
                        Append-only audit log the attest sidecar writes to (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_AUDIT_LOG)
  --attest-pre-state PATH
                        Existing pre-actuation system-of-record snapshot for delta checks. When
                        omitted, replay captures one into the run directory
                        (attest_pre_state.json) before actuation begins (env fallback:
                        OPENADAPT_FLOW_ATTEST_PRE_STATE)
  --approver-policy FILE
                        An openadapt.approver-policy/v1 JSON file: which kinds of approver
                        (person, rule, agent, system) may answer each class of save. Without it
                        only a person may answer. A clinical_write save takes a non-person
                        approver only when the policy pins an opt-in.
  --approver-webhook URL
                        Ask this https endpoint (the customer's approver agent or system) about
                        each waiting save, with HMAC-signed, PHI-free messages. The secret is read
                        from OPENADAPT_APPROVER_WEBHOOK_SECRET. A person can still answer in
                        Desktop. Needs --approver-webhook-id and a policy that allows the
                        approver's kind.
  --approver-webhook-id APPROVER_WEBHOOK_ID
                        The webhook approver's opaque id, such as system:acme-approvals
  --approver-webhook-kind {agent,system}
                        Whether the webhook approver is an agent or a system (default system)
  --approval-mode {each_item,problems_only,not_gated}
                        Per-item approval before each consequential save. each_item (the default
                        for every run): the run waits before every save until a person approves it
                        in Desktop's Run it (see `item-approval`). problems_only: only problems go
                        to a person; until a switch record is configured, every save still asks.
                        not_gated: no per-item pause, recorded in the report (the hosted runner,
                        Execute and MCP callers). Overrides runtime.approval_mode. A resume always
                        keeps the run's own mode.
  --approval-wait SECONDS
                        How long the run waits for a person's answer before it stops before the
                        save (default 900, at most 14400). An answer given later can still be used
                        by `resume`.
```

```text
                        source for Markdown/docs; json: the shared program-graph spec every
                        surface renders
  -o OUT, --out OUT     Write to this file instead of stdout (parent dirs are created)
  --profile {operator-local,remote-safe,public-synthetic,sanitized-derivative}
                        Data boundary for the rendered view. Non-local profiles remove recorded
                        text, values, selectors, URLs, free-text predicates, and local provenance.
                        Projection is not source sanitization.
```

### `openadapt-flow countersign`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow countersign [-h]
                                  {add,exceptions,resolve,close,purge,timestamp-baseline,disclose,verify,dossier}
                                  ...

positional arguments:
  {add,exceptions,resolve,close,purge,timestamp-baseline,disclose,verify,dossier}
    add                 Add a countersign block: field commitments, RFC 3161 timestamp,
                        countersignature
    exceptions          List Seals queued on a REFUTED or INDETERMINATE outcome
    resolve             Resolve an exception with a later verified Seal that links to it
    close               Close an exception with a disposition signed by a person whose key is
                        pinned
    purge               Export, then delete, closed exceptions past their retention period
    timestamp-baseline  Timestamp a baseline read before the executor runs
    disclose            Write a disclosure bundle revealing chosen committed fields
    verify              Check a Seal offline and show executor, verification tier, timestamps, and
                        disclosures
    dossier             Export one offline-verifiable HTML or zip for a dispute

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `openadapt-flow countersign add`

```text
usage: openadapt-flow countersign add [-h] -o OUT [--fields-file FIELDS_FILE]
                                      [--tsa-url TSA_URL | --no-timestamp | --tsa-local DIR]
                                      [--tsa-cert PEM] [--baseline-timestamp BASELINE_TIMESTAMP]
                                      [--countersign-key COUNTERSIGN_KEY] [--vault VAULT]
                                      [--keys KEYS] [--retention-days RETENTION_DAYS]
                                      document

positional arguments:
  document              Receipt, effect-receipt wire document, or report.json

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o OUT, --out OUT     Countersigned document to write (mode 0600)
  --fields-file FIELDS_FILE
                        JSON object of sensitive fields to commit; values go to the vault only
  --tsa-url TSA_URL     RFC 3161 TSA URL (default: Sigstore's timestamp.sigstore.dev). Only a
                        32-byte digest is sent
  --no-timestamp        Do not request a timestamp (offline use)
  --tsa-local DIR       Offline TSA keeping its key in DIR. Test only: its time is this machine's
                        clock
  --tsa-cert PEM        Pinned TSA certificate or CA the new token must verify against before it
                        is kept (repeatable; default: the bundled Sigstore TSA root)
  --baseline-timestamp BASELINE_TIMESTAMP
                        Output of 'countersign timestamp-baseline' for this run
  --countersign-key COUNTERSIGN_KEY
                        Ed25519 PEM for a local countersignature
  --vault VAULT         Vault directory (default $OPENADAPT_COUNTERSIGN_VAULT or
                        ~/.openadapt/countersign-vault)
  --keys KEYS           Pinned Seal key registry used to decide whether to queue an exception
  --retention-days RETENTION_DAYS
                        Keep a closed exception this long (default 2190, minimum 183, or
                        $OPENADAPT_EXCEPTION_RETENTION_DAYS)
```
